results.title: CloudVault: Drive Backup
results.snippet:
CloudVault is a simple and organized cloud storage app designed to help you keep your photos, videos, audio files, documents and other files together in one place.

Upload your files to your CloudVault account, organize them into folders, quickly access recently added content, mark important files as favorites, and view supported media directly inside the app.

CloudVault also includes a separate private Vault protected by a PIN, giving you an additional space for media you want to keep away from the regular cloud library.

Organize your cloud files

Upload and manage different types of content, including photos, videos, audio and documents. Create folders to keep your files organized and easily find the content you need.

You can rename, duplicate, move, share, download and delete supported cloud files directly from the app.

Photos and videos

Browse uploaded photos and video thumbnails from your media library and folders.

Open photos in the built-in image viewer or play uploaded videos using the integrated video player.

Audio player

Keep audio files in your cloud storage and play them directly inside CloudVault using the built-in audio player.

Playback controls include play and pause, seeking, forward and rewind controls, and repeat playback.

Private Vault

CloudVault includes a separate PIN-protected Vault for private media.

You can organize Vault content into folders and access photos, videos, audio and files from your protected Vault area.

Vault access is locked again when you leave the Vault section, helping keep private content separated from the rest of the app.

Recent files and favorites

Quickly access recently added cloud files from the Recent section.

Mark supported cloud files as favorites so important content is easier to find later.

File management

CloudVault provides useful file-management actions such as:

* Create and manage folders
* Rename files and folders
* Duplicate files and folders
* Move files between folders
* Add or remove cloud files from Favorites
* View file and folder details
* Share supported files with other apps
* Download supported media to your device
* Delete files and folders when no longer needed

Storage information

See how much cloud storage your account is using and monitor available storage directly from the app.

Folder details also show useful information such as item count and storage usage.

Account and security

Manage your account information and security preferences from the Profile section.

CloudVault includes account sign-out and account deletion controls, along with Vault PIN and security-question recovery features.

Clean and easy interface

CloudVault is designed with a simple interface that makes it easy to browse cloud files, switch between media categories, manage folders and access private Vault content without unnecessary complexity.

CloudVault helps you keep your digital files organized, accessible and easier to manage from one place.

results.snippet:
Vault is a mobile app designed to hide private photos, videos on your phone. Currently there are more than 100 million users worldwide using Vault to protect their mobile privacy while enjoying App Lock, Private Bookmark, Incognito Browser, Cloud Backup and many other helpful features for completely free! Join them now!

Top Features

☆ Hide and Protect Photos & videos: Photos and videos imported into phone can only be viewed or played after the correct password is entered. These photos and videos can also be backed up to Cloud Space for better protection.

☆ App Lock (Privacy Protection): Use App Lock to protect your social, photo, call logs and telephone apps to prevent privacy leak.

☆ Private Browser: With Private browser, your internet surf will leave no traces behind. There is also Private Bookmark feature.

☆ Cloud Backup: Back up your photos and videos to Cloud so they never get lost.

☆ Data Transfer:With Cloud Backup feature, you could easily transfer your data to a new phone by cross-device synchronization.

☆ Password recovery: Worried about forgetting your password? Set a security email in Vault so you can retrieve it.

Advanced Features

► Multiple Vault & Fake Vault
Create multiple vaults with different passwords for storing photos, videos respectively. And one of them can be a fake vault.

► Stealth Mode
Make Vault icon disappear from your home screen and it can only be found again with the correct password, so no one knows it exists.

► Break-in Alerts
Secretly snaps a picture of any one who attempts to access with a wrong password. Vault captures a photo, the time stamp and PIN code entered by all intruders.

Support:

► Q&A:

1. What if I forgot my password?

If you have a security Email set up before, you should be able to see a "Forgot Password" en-trance once you input the wrong password. Tap on the entrance and follow the instructions to reset your password.

If you do not have a security Email but you had backed up your data to cloud space, then the data can be recovered from the cloud by reinstalling Vault app.


2. How do I enter vault in stealth mode？


1. Put Vault back to the phone’s home screen by adding Vault widget, once it appears on home screen, tap on it, and then input your password to enter, or,

2. Download "NQ calculator" in Google Play, open it, and input correct password then tap "=".


3. Why are my photos/videos lost?

Some cleaning or free storage apps may automatically delete Vault’s data folder used to store pictures and videos. So, as a best practice, please do not choose to delete Vault’s data folder and subfolders (mnt/sdcard/SystemAndroid) when you use such apps.

You can also backup your pictures and videos to cloud by using "Cloud Backup" feature in the premium page of Vault.

This app uses the Device Administrator permission.

Your data is always encrypted on a device and in a cloud with a strong 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This algorithm is used by the U.S. Government for protection of a top secret information. AES is also widely adopted worldwide and became the de facto encryption standard.

Your database is automatically synchronized with your own cloud account. Thus you can easily restore your entire database from a cloud to a new phone or computer (in case of a loss or an upgrade). Your phone, tablet and computer are also automatically synchronized between each other via a cloud.

You can autofill logins and passwords on webpages in Chrome. For that you should enable SafeInCloud Autofill service in the phone's Accessibility settings.
